target: 3-class externally-imposed memory load (5 / 9 / 13 digit sequence length), memory-condition trials only
target_choice_note: The externally-imposed sequence length is used, NOT the subjective NASA-TLX workload ratings present in participants.tsv, per the master prompt's explicit preference for an externally-imposed target - NASA-TLX scores are CONTEXT_ONLY.
reference: Trigger-code-derived condition label (memory vs control, digit position, sequence length) - read from the real events.tsv/events.json sidecars, never the raw trigger-code string itself passed as a feature (see leakage matrix).

cohort.eligibility_rule: EEG_excluded == 'no' in participants.tsv (confirmed via direct file read this sprint)

sparse_channel_selection.rationale: AF7/AF8/TP9/TP10 is the EXACT electrode montage used by the Muse consumer EEG headband, a real, currently-shipping wearable product - choosing it ties the 'sparse wearable-compatible subset' framing to an actual physical device's real electrode geometry rather than an arbitrary 4-channel guess. All four channels are CONFIRMED present in ds003838's real 63-channel montage (verified directly from sub-032's channels.tsv this sprint) - this was checked, not assumed, before freezing the choice. Chosen for anatomical coverage (frontal + posterior-temporal, spatially diverse rather than four adjacent electrodes) and real wearable relevance, not by testing which channels perform best.

experiment_type: A/B/C sensor/coverage marginal-value ablation - a new question type for this project (spatial coverage minimalism, not multi-modal sensor fusion)

feature_sets.A: Sparse EEG subset: AF7, AF8, TP9, TP10
feature_sets.C: Full-montage architecture, with all channels BEYOND the 4 frozen A channels temporally deranged ACROSS TRIALS within subject (never across subjects) - A's 4 channels remain real/aligned in C, isolating whether the EXTRA 59 channels' real alignment (vs. their mere presence/capacity) matters.

model_fairness.problem: A (4 channels) and B (63 channels) differ enormously in input dimensionality - naively giving B a proportionally larger encoder would confound 'more real channels help' with 'more parameters help.'
model_fairness.design: Channel-wise shared encoder: a single per-channel 1D-CNN encoder (identical weights applied to every channel independently) followed by a fixed-width aggregation (mean or attention-pooling) to a constant-size representation, so the total parameter count is (nearly) IDENTICAL between A and B - only the number of channels fed through the shared encoder differs. This directly implements the 'avoid giving the full montage a huge parameter advantage' requirement.
model_fairness.control_c_masking: In C, the 59 non-frozen channels are still passed through the same shared encoder (preserving capacity), but their trial-to-trial temporal alignment is destroyed - isolating the alignment question from the capacity question, which the shared-encoder design already controls for.

preprocessing.bandpass_hz: TBD at Stage-2 implementation, frozen before training (standard EEG range, e.g. 0.5-40 Hz, exact values to be recorded in the Stage-2 result artifact's frozen_protocol block)
preprocessing.notch_hz: 50 Hz (PowerLineFrequency confirmed as 50 in the real eeg.json sidecar this sprint - NOT 60 Hz, verified not assumed)
preprocessing.downsampling: None planned (native 1000 Hz retained) unless a documented resource-driven reason forces a change - to be disclosed if it happens
preprocessing.referencing: As recorded (FCz reference, Fpz ground) - re-referencing scheme, if any, to be frozen at Stage-2 implementation before training
preprocessing.artifact_rejection: Frozen, label-independent rule only (e.g. fixed amplitude threshold) - no test-set-informed or outcome-informed rejection
preprocessing.trial_epoching: Per-digit-position epochs anchored to the real trigger onsets (events.tsv), window length TBD at Stage-2 implementation, frozen before training

split_strategy: Subject-wise CV, no trials from one subject across train/test - standard for this project.

resource_feasibility.eeg_only_estimate_gb: ~96-99 GB for full 65-subject, both-task EEG download (directly measured this sprint via git-annex object sizes - see ds003838_metadata_audit_stage1b.json)
resource_feasibility.assessment: MEDIUM-HIGH, not the previously-feared ~250 GB EXTREME/HIGH - a real, actionable number now that actual file sizes are known.
resource_feasibility.mitigation_if_impractical: If the full 65-subject download proves impractical within the project timeline, a neutral-rule preregistered subject subset (e.g. every 3rd eligible subject_id in sorted order, or the first N by subject_id - a rule chosen BEFORE seeing any data content) may be used, per Section 15's explicit allowance - never an outcome-driven convenience subset.
resource_feasibility.task_scope_option: The 'rest' task (4 min, ~45 MB/subject) is not needed for the frozen A/B/C (which is memory-task-only) and can be skipped entirely, saving negligible space relative to the memory task's ~1.47 GiB/subject dominant cost.

secondary_metrics: ordinal error (mean absolute rank distance across 5/9/13, given the natural ordering)
leakage_exclusions: raw trigger-code string as a feature
condition (control vs memory) conflated into the length target
subject_sensitivity: Report per-subject A-vs-B delta for all 65 eligible subjects, favorable-direction count, dominance/concentration.

negative_result_policy.if_candidate_helps: Report as: 'the full 63-channel montage added information about digit-span memory load beyond the frozen 4-channel wearable-relevant subset, in this cohort/task.'
negative_result_policy.if_candidate_does_not_help: Report as: 'the sparse wearable-relevant 4-channel subset retained comparable memory-load information to the full montage, in this cohort/task' - a genuinely useful minimalism finding for this project's mission, reported honestly either way.
negative_result_policy.if_shuffled_control_equals_candidate: Full-montage benefit (if any) attributable to raw channel-presence/capacity, not genuine spatial alignment across trials.

forbidden_claims: AF7/AF8/TP9/TP10 is validated for spaceflight cognitive monitoring.
This result applies beyond the digit-span task tested.
implementation_cost: MEDIUM-HIGH (largest raw-data footprint of the five candidates by a wide margin, though smaller than previously estimated)
classification_reason: Actual-file-verified cohort (65/86 usable via participants.tsv, cross-checked against the README's independent enumeration and found to agree exactly), real externally-imposed target, anatomically-justified and product-matched sparse channel set frozen before any results, real fairness-preserving shared-encoder design. Classified WITH_LIMITATIONS due to genuine resource cost (~96-99 GB) even though this sprint's real measurement substantially reduced the previously-feared estimate, and because per-subject uniformity of the montage/preprocessing was checked on only one representative subject (sub-032) rather than all 65 this sprint.
